title: `CREATE3.deploy` — Salt Collision / Front-Running of Deterministic Addresses
impact: `CREATE3.deploy(salt, ...)` computes the final address purely from `salt` and `address(this)`. If a protocol uses a predictable salt (e.g., `keccak256(user)`), an attacker can front-run the deployment by calling `deploy` with the same salt from the **same contract** (if the function is permissionless), causing the legitimate deployment to revert with `DEPLOYMENT_FAILED` (create2 returns 0 on collision). This is a griefing/Do
